description: This file is a makefile fragment for configuring and building Linux kernel components within the OpenWrt build system. It includes definitions for preparing kernel sources, setting up initramfs, compiling modules, copying images, and cleaning build artifacts, with conditional logic based on configuration options.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares kernel source based on whether external kernel tree or source archive is used.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration for initramfs, adjusting config options based on build settings.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the kernel configuration for initramfs, including compression and root permissions.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs configuration from the kernel config.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel using a specified command, copying kernel settings, and generating version info.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Configures the kernel for initramfs using the SetInitramfs method.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules and updates configuration timestamps.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies kernel images and vmlinux binary to the build directory, with optional debug info.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and copies it to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/PrepareConfigPerRootfs
methods.description: Prepares a separate kernel configuration directory per root filesystem.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds initramfs image if configured, including compression and copying to build directory.

methods.name: Kernel/Clean/Default
methods.description: Cleans kernel build artifacts and configuration files.
